test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which is NOT correct about India's Prime Minister?

options.text: He is the head of the government.
He is the leader of the majority party in Lok Sabha.
He can be removed if a no confidence motion is passed by both the Houses of Parliament with a 2/3rd majority.
He is appointed by the President of India.

solution:
The correct answer is __**O**__**__ption 3.__**

__
 
• The Prime Minister can be removed from office by a vote of no confidence passed by a **simple majority** of the members of the **Lok Sabha**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Article 75 of the Indian Constitution mentions that a Prime Minister is one who is appointed by the President.

 
 
• There is no specific procedure for his appointment.
